purpose: Select actor step sizes and test guarded policy geometry while retaining reward critic, evidence critic and evidence-priced replay.

algorithm_contract.ordinary: Section 3 score-function actor; predictable actor/reward/evidence step schedules
algorithm_contract.projected_ordinary: Explicit CEAC optimizer variant: same two TD errors, score step, then KL projection onto an interior simplex
algorithm_contract.natural_mirror: Explicit CEAC optimizer variant: fresh on-policy TD estimate, statewise natural/mirror step, KL trust limit and interior-simplex projection
algorithm_contract.critic_update_order: Freeze both TD errors, update actor, then both critics
algorithm_contract.replay: Unchanged immutable policy labels and empirical certified evidence prices; no off-policy actor gradients
algorithm_contract.information_access: No evaluator Q values, true task labels or exact expected gradients enter learning

schedule.clock: Fresh actor visits to the particular state; not total environment episodes
schedule.projection: KL projection q_i=max(epsilon/K, c*w_i), c chosen to make sum(q)=1; not clip then renormalize
schedule.trust_backtracking: Shrink actor step until the post-projection KL bound holds; record every contraction

ranking: minimum worst-cell final actor augmented gap
simpler geometry then lexicographic candidate id

confirmation.status: only after candidate selection is frozen
confirmation.comparison: Matched new seeds and physical budgets; historical seeds 0/1/2 remain descriptive regression checks, never hyperparameter selection. Any new headline comparison to external algorithms needs those comparators evaluated on the same confirmation seeds.

required_diagnostics: external regret and late behavior reward gap
unconstrained and floor-constrained actor augmented-objective gaps
minimum valid action probability and total nuisance probability
actual visits to the currently best priced action
actor entropy, Fisher conditioning and policy KL per update
reward/evidence TD and gradient second moments
effective evidence critic step: alpha_I times squared norm(beta)
floor mass and its cumulative sum
replay counts, price levels and confidence radii
notes: These are optimizer settings for the complete CEAC loop, not actor-only ablations or external comparator methods.
Natural-gradient and projected updates must be labeled as optimizer variants; they are not literally the currently implemented score-function equation.
The old kernels and studies must remain reconstructible. Implement variants outside frozen numerical-source packages until source-version migration is explicitly handled.
The schedule exponents satisfy a standard bounded-noise surrogate condition; this is not a convergence or Graves-Lai regret theorem for adaptive CEAC.
